# Bad changes: caught before any router saw them

**15 / 15 caught by the static gates** (SoT validation, redundancy rule, capacity what-if). Generated by `python tests/bad_changes.py`; enforced by `tests/test_bad_changes.py` on every PR.

| # | Bad change | Caught by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | overlapping subnets on two links | SoT validation: L23: subnet 10.1.12.0/30 overlaps 10.1.12.0/30 |
| 2 | lightpath on a fibre that doesn't exist (typo) | SoT validation: L34: unknown fibre F43 |
| 3 | lightpath route with a gap | SoT validation: L13: fibre F34 does not continue the lightpath from r2 |
| 4 | lightpath that doesn't reach the link's far end | SoT validation: L13: lightpath ends at r2, not r3 |
| 5 | same router interface used twice | SoT validation: h3: interface r3:eth1 used twice |
| 6 | link to a router that doesn't exist | SoT validation: L41: unknown router r5; L41: lightpath ends at r4, not r5 |
| 7 | OSPF cost 0 | SoT validation: L12: ospf_cost out of range |
| 8 | core link not a /30 | SoT validation: L12: core links use /30 |
| 9 | redundancy removed (a router left on a single link) | redundancy rule: a core link without an alternate path |
| 10 | new demand overloads a link above 80 % | capacity what-if: L13 above 80% |
| 11 | two routers with the same router-id | SoT validation: r4: router id 3 already used by r3 |
| 12 | two ONTs on the same splitter port | SoT validation: ont4: splitter port spl1:1 used twice |
| 13 | ONT on a splitter port that doesn't exist | SoT validation: ont4: port 40 outside 1..32 |
| 14 | PON subnet overlapping a customer LAN | SoT validation: olt1: subnet 100.64.3.0/24 overlaps 100.64.3.0/24 |
| 15 | eBGP upstream with our own ASN (session would be iBGP) | SoT validation: up1: upstream ASN 65000 equals our own ASN (the eBGP session would be iBGP) |
